decisions: The local docs/specs/spec-002-approved-local-patch-writes.md is the authoritative source; the similarly numbered Windows-runner spec is unrelated.
The requested branch is codex/spec-002-approved-local-patch-writes, created from the current 0437169 baseline with dirty state preserved.

SPEC-002 V1 write ownership is supported only on Linux/WSL; non-Linux write-owner acquisition returns WRITE_OWNER_UNAVAILABLE and write surfaces stay unavailable.
The broker admin routes are the only local write-request admin surface; the legacy bridge remains read-only.
Implicit local CLI selection uses the deepest registered or valid concrete worktree containing cwd; main worktree requests are filtered separately from derived worktree requests.

Keep the legacy per-project bridge read-only and keep mutation annotations truthful.

risks: Arbitrary external filesystem writers remain outside C2C's process-level ownership and lifecycle serialization; the existing stale checks and rollback safeguards retain their documented TOCTOU limits.
